svg.title: Flights pay their way
svg.text: The more drones fly, the more the city can see, and the less any one block carries. Operators pay for
their place in the sky with data; a burden budget keeps the loop from running away.
Use a city launch site, share a
get a citywide weather and route
that monitor their own fence line,
with data sent straight to CDPH.
Sensors built to one city standard
CDPH orders a detour from the menu
and pays operators in better terms
to fly over thin, burdened blocks.
Checked by: the residents (panels can ask for a lower budget for their block) and the agencies (one front door and a cap on
total asks, so goodwill isn't used up). Orange dot = CDPH's own use.
